snippet.title: House of Necrosis Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
House of Necrosis is a turn-based horror RPG with retro 32-bit 3D graphics. Survive the horrors of the mansion that changes every time you enter.

House of Necrosis launches Oct 6 on Steam (Windows & Linux). Wishlist now!
